title: Which of a regional municipality's 30 permanent traffic count stations' 2027 counts are off by more than 5 per cent from the vehicles that passed them, for the annual count report and the maintenance contractor's spring recalibration, with the report's maintenance visits and power failures by district and quarter
subdomain: missing-data-censoring-measurement-error (inductive loop count stations' counting error: a sensitivity read on summer validation days, a loss in queued traffic read from bridges' paired approaches, and the older controllers' miss on cold days read from the bridges whose approaches run one controller of each generation)
prompt_shape: other: the stations to flag, the chart of every station's 2027 error against the 5 per cent band with the flagged stations marked, the maintenance visits and the power failures by district and quarter
stated_inputs: the 5 per cent tolerance and the definitions of section 5 and section 7 of the Region's standard TDP-03

sources.origin: generated by task251/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional Ontario regional municipality: 30 permanent count stations on its regional roads, ten of them on the two approaches of five one-lane river bridges, each direction's hourly demand through a year of school terms, holidays and months, queues where a bottleneck lies downstream, a year of daily temperatures at the region's airport, loops that count each vehicle with the station's sensitivity and lose a share that grows with occupancy in queued traffic, older controllers that miss a share on cold days, a summer validation day per station, two controller replacements, grid outages and feeder re-trips, the maintenance contractor's routes, faults and office resets, the validation crew's and the Region's own cabinet openings; the Region, its contractors and every person are invented, the practice follows published traffic monitoring practice, and no real dataset is reproduced.
